learned_optimizations.title: Batch API requests to reduce execution time
learned_optimizations.description: When processing multiple items, use n8n's batch processing capabilities instead of item-by-item loops
learned_optimizations.before: Loop through 100 items, make API call for each
learned_optimizations.after: Batch 100 items into chunks of 10, make 10 API calls

learned_optimizations.title: Implement error workflow for critical automations
learned_optimizations.description: Create dedicated error handling workflows instead of inline error nodes
learned_optimizations.before: Error nodes in each workflow with duplicate logic
learned_optimizations.after: Centralized error workflow called from all critical workflows
learned_optimizations.impact: Reduced error handling code by 70%, improved consistency

learned_optimizations.title: Use workflow deduplication to prevent duplicate executions
learned_optimizations.description: Add execution tracking to prevent duplicate webhook processing
learned_optimizations.after: Check execution history before processing webhook
learned_optimizations.impact: Reduced duplicate executions by 85%, saved API costs

learned_optimizations.title: Enable execution data saving for debugging
learned_optimizations.description: Save execution data for failed workflows to enable post-mortem analysis
learned_optimizations.before: Failed executions had no data, debugging was difficult
learned_optimizations.after: All failures save execution data with full context
